nodes.name: Get Google Ads credentials
nodes.notes: After import, set this node's credential to your Supabase project (Settings > Credentials > Supabase â€” URL + service_role key). This node type/parameter set is unverified against your actual n8n version (I have no live access to confirm it) â€” if it errors on first run, check the node's error message against the Supabase node's actual current parameters and adjust. Reads the single row from google_ads_settings (managed from the dashboard's /settings page) instead of hardcoding secrets in this workflow.

nodes.name: Prepare context
nodes.notes: Throws (stopping the whole execution, visible in n8n's execution log) if the row is missing or has no linked Google Ads account. Unlike the Python version, this workflow does NOT automatically write status='error' back to Supabase on failure â€” check the execution log and reset the row manually if something goes wrong partway through.

nodes.name: Refresh Google Ads token
nodes.notes: Client id/secret/refresh token now come from the 'Get Google Ads credentials' node (Supabase) instead of being hardcoded. This access token is short-lived (~1hr) and is re-fetched on every workflow run, so that's fine. Every Google Ads HTTP Request node below reads it via {{ $('Refresh Google Ads token').item.json.access_token }}.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ operations: [{ create: { name: `${$('Prepare context').item.json.campaignName} Budget ${Date.now()}`, amountMicros: String(Math.round($('Prepare context').item.json.dailyBudgetUsd * 1000000)), deliveryMethod: 'STANDARD', explicitlyShared: false } }] }) }}

nodes.name: Create budget
nodes.notes: developer-token and login-customer-id now come from the Supabase-backed credentials node â€” same pattern applies to every Google Ads node below.

nodes.name: Suggest geo targets
nodes.notes: Sends all targeted_locations in ONE suggest call rather than one call per location (which the Python version did, for a cleaner 1:1 best-match per location). This is a simplification: it takes the first (highest-relevance) suggestion per distinct matched search term in the Code node below, which is close but not guaranteed identical to the per-location version. Worth spot-checking the resulting geo criteria in the Google Ads UI after a build.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ operations: [{ create: { name: `${$('Prepare context').item.json.businessName} Negatives ${Date.now()}`, type: 'NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS' } }] }) }}
